Wherefore ← wherefore.build

What builds what

Every tracked file in wherefore.build, how it is made, and what reads what. Sources on the left, the scripts that read them in the middle, everything they make on the right. Choose anything to trace its chain.

Captured, and stamped

Files nobody can regenerate here, like a render or a copy from elsewhere. Each is stamped with what it was made from, so the gate knows when it is out of date.

Written, not built, with a reason

Everything else is written - by a person, or by an agent - and never built: nothing regenerates it, so it is current only while someone keeps it so. Every rule that says so carries its reason.

Unclassified

Nothing wrote these during the run and nothing declares them. The gate fails each one.

Made by wherefore graph (Wherefore 0.12.0): every generator run once with the engine's observer recording what each opened and wrote, every tracked file classified the way the gate classifies it, and the tree put back as it was. Nothing on this page is written; all of it is built.
